lines.en: label toukacamp1:
scene black
I haven’t had much time to think about her lately, but...
Now that I have Touka’s number, I’m sure she wouldn’t mind if I gave her a call. Right?
I know it’s late...and I know I may have ghosted her for months while I was lying in bed mostly unconscious. But things are better now. Kind of.
And I think that, with her, they can get even better than that.
Or maybe that’s just wishful thinking and my voice will do naught but annoy her now that she isn’t used to it anymore.
scene toukacampcall1
: Hello?
: Hey. I’d like to place an order for delivery.
: Apologies, I believe you may have the wrong number. This is Touka Tsukioka of the Tsukioka-
: Just one large with pepperoni. Thanks.
: One large with-
: Actually, add some garlic knots to that as well. Thanks.
: Uh- hold on one moment. Let me find a pen.
scene toukacampcall2
: Mother- you don’t happen to be carrying a pen, do you?
: A pen? For what, dear?
: A delivery order. One large with pepperoni and garlic knots.
: A large what?
: I’m not sure. Let me confirm.
scene toukacampcall3
: Sir, are you still there? A large what, exactly?
: Touka, it’s me.
: Oh, apologies again. I’ve yet to take down your name. Please wait one moment while my manager obtains something for me to write with.
: Touka, I’m not actually placing a delivery order. I’m fucking with you.
: Fucking?
: One large fucking with pepperoni and garlic knots. I’ll inform the kitchen staff right away.
: Your order will be ready in thirty to forty-five minutes, sir.
: Got it. Thanks again, Tina.
scene toukacampcall4
: Nevermind, Mother. It’s just Sensei. I can tell by his failure to correctly say my name.
: Hey, I tried. But you probably didn’t recognize my voice because I was using the correct name.
: What does Sensei want with a large pepperoni fucking?
: Are the delivery parlors near his home-
scene toukacampcall5
: Oh! This must be one of those “crank calls” I have heard about on the television. He wasn’t actually ordering anything at all, was he?
: Do you think I have time for your games, Sensei? I’d have gladly answered if your intention was not to toy with my emotions and consume precious business hours.
scene toukacampcall1
: My bad. I’ve once again underestimated just how out of the loop you and your mother are.
: Yes, well, there are plenty of loops we’re involved in that you could never even hope to come into contact with. So what do you really want? There isn’t a problem with your apartment, is there?
: No. I’m actually in the woods right now.
: The...woods? Are you in trouble? Do you need me to send someone to-
: I’m just camping.
: Camping?
: It’s when you go hang out in the woods and then ultimately go to sleep there.
: One moment, Sensei.
scene toukacampcall6
: Mother, have you heard of something called “camping” before?
: Why, yes. I believe that’s when a group of commoners go into a wooded area with the intention of creating some form of recreational shelter and...starting fires?
: Why would they do such a thing?
: I’m not sure, dear. The poor do all sorts of strange things, but we mustn’t question their customs for that could be one of us one day.
scene toukacampcall7
: Sensei? Are you still there?
scene toukacampcall8
: Yes. And I heard all of that.
: Oh, splendid. Then, would you mind explaining to me why you’d willingly do something like “camping?” Are you that desperate to get away from everyone that you’d isolate yourself in the woods?
: I’m not isolating myself. I’m here with Ami and some of my other friends.
: Since when do you have friends?
: I don’t know. They’ve just kind of always been around. But it doesn’t really matter why I’m out here. What matters is that I wanted to talk to you.
: About what, exactly?
scene toukacampcall9
: Does there actually need to be a reason?
: Because I don’t have one.
scene toukacampcall10
: I kind of just wanted to hear your voice.
: You...
scene toukacampcall11
: You’re only saying that to get a rise out of me...just like when you ordered the pepperoni fucking.
: Maybe I am, maybe I’m not. Can you talk or not, though? Because I was kind of hoping we could maybe do this without Tsubasa looming over your shoulder.
: Regardless of the reason, you’ve chosen a terrible time to do this. I’m in the middle of-
scene toukacampcall12
: Wow, I sure am tired all of a sudden.
: Uhh...please hold again, Sensei.
: Mother, weren’t you just saying a moment ago how much energy you’ve had as of late?
scene toukacampcall13
: Yes. But I must have forgotten to mention how today is the exception to that.
: So, if you’d please excuse me, I believe it’s time that I retire for the evening.
: If...that is what you believe to be best, then-
scene toukacampcall14
: Goodnight, dear. And please don’t stay up too late. We have guests coming in the morning that we must be prepared for.
: Y...Yes, Mother. I understand.
scene toukacampcall1
: Sensei? Are you still there?
: Yes. And again, I heard all of that. Phones pick up a lot now, Touka.
: Then...I suppose it appears that I do have time to talk after all. But I’m still not quite sure of what’s going on here.
: From what I understand, one does not typically call another just to hear their voice.
: People in relationships do.
: But the two of us do not have the sort of “relationship” you’re referring to at the moment.
: But we do have a relationship.
: If you want to be that vague, I have a relationship with many people.
: Sure. But do you feel the same way when you’re talking to me that you feel with any of them?
: Are you referring to the innate desire to reach through the telephone and smack the side of your head?
: Yeah. I’m pretty sure they call that “love” in some cultures.
: Hah...what have I gotten myself into now?
scene black
I remain on the phone with Touka as she walks through the halls of the manor. And, throughout that time, I fill her in on why I’m out here and what I hope to accomplish with Ami.
Or I guess...what I’ve already somehow accomplished.
It feels weird to share any of this with one of her classmates, though. Even if I barely look at Touka as another teenager in the first place when she acts so much more mature than the rest of them.
And yes, I know that sort of statement makes me sound deplorable and that it would never hold up in a court of law, but I mean it.
I wouldn’t see her as some sort of matriarch if I was getting high off of her hormones. And I certainly wouldn’t be calling her in the middle of the night just to “talk.”
But the fact of the matter is that I just wanted to hear her voice. And another fact of the matter is that I know she wanted to hear mine.
scene toukacampcall15
But those ways do not run parallel with one another.
They violently intersect, slicing each other in half, and all we can do is wait to feel the after-effects and hope that most of our limbs remain intact.
For right now, this is perfect.
But I know it can’t stay this way forever.
: You’re on speaker, Sensei. So please do me a favor and keep the inappropriate language to a minimum. You never know just who is listening around here.
: You and your mother were literally just talking about “pepperoni fucking” like ten minutes ago.
: Yes, but that was when I was under the impression that “fucking” was simply a slang term for a food item I’d never heard before.
: You must remember that there’s a great deal I still don’t understand about your world, Sensei.
: Oh, I don’t need to remember. You remind me every time I talk to you.
scene toukacampcall16
: Then you most assuredly do require a reminder as you had no qualms at all with completely ignoring me for several months.
: I completely ignored everyone for several months, Touka.
: Yes. But you and I have a relationship, don’t we?
: Isn’t that what you said just a short while ago, Sensei?
: I mean...yeah.
scene toukacampcall17
: So that relationship only exists when it benefits you?
: That’s not what I’m saying.

: Then please explain what you mean a little better. Because your earlier words implied that there was some sort of connection between us and now you’re making it sound like I’m no different from anyone at all.
: Which one is it, Sensei? Do tell.
: I’m sorry for ignoring you, Touka.
: As you should be. I’m disappointed in you.
scene toukacampcall18
: Don’t think I didn’t notice how frequently your eyes landed on me at the Halloween party, Sensei.
: You mean the one where I literally sought you out and asked you to stay with me? Because yeah, that would typically involve a certain amount of eye contact.
: And what? You just...stopped desiring such a thing once that night came to an end? Did you think for a moment about how that would make me feel?
scene toukacampcall19
: If one second I’m important to you and the next I’m not, how is that any different than the more playful ways in which you tug at my strings, Sensei?
: It’s starting to sound like I’m in trouble right now.
: Because you are. But I’m kind enough to not make you grovel at my feet and beg for forgiveness.
: Then tell me, kind and wonderful Touka, what must I do to be forgiven?
scene toukacampcall1
: Simply doing what I ask you to do means nothing to me when I have the power to make you do anything I want, Sensei.
: Your mother would be so proud right now.
: If you truly want to mend the wound that you have inflicted upon us, you will come up with a solution. I will not coddle you 100%% of the way.
: How about 90%%?
: That sounds much more manageable. I accept.
: But I hope you understand that this means you will be putting in a certain amount of work as well.
: I think I can probably manage 10%%.
scene toukacampcall20
: I would sure hope so. I can only imagine how destined to fail this relationship would be if both of us were incapable of acting our age.
: You’re probably even further off than I am, to be honest.
: Yes, because I’m a mature and responsible young woman while you’re a blubbering lunatic who wastes his precious phone time on a girl half his age.
scene toukacampcall1
: That’s me alright.
: I’m glad you called, Sensei.
: I’m always happy to hear your voice.
: Even when it torments me.
: I’m not tormenting you right now, am I?
: You most certainly are- forcing me to have a conversation this intimate over the telephone rather than appearing before me in person.
: Is “intimate” the right word here?
: Are we not privately sharing our feelings with one another? Is that not what intimacy is?
: I just typically associate that word with something else.
scene toukacampcall21
: That’s because you’re a bastard and I’m a princess.
: At least half of that statement is correct.
: Which half?
: The former, obviously. Being a princess requires a little more than just being rich.
: There you go again, squandering a perfect opportunity to mend the wound you’ve inflicted by pouring salt in it.
: I formally apologize for knowing the textbook definition of “princess.”
: Apology accepted. Now, apologize for setting my mind ablaze during your two month absence.
: Ablaze? You thought about me that much?
scene toukacampcall22
: Considering the last look I had at you was met with a glance that screamed “save me,” yes. I thought about you quite a bit.
: I worried almost constantly. But I was also furious with you, Sensei.
scene toukacampcall9
: Which is ultimately why I elected to not save you at all when all it would have taken was one phone call.
: So...maybe I do want to see you grovel. Just a little bit.
: I’ll make sure to do that the next time I see you.
: And when will that be?
: When do you want it to be?
: I want you to start living up to that 10%% and make your own decisions about what to do with me rather than letting me guide you the whole way. Did I not make that clear enough?
: I can promise you that you do not want me making the decisions about “what to do with you.”
: Are you being a bastard again? Insinuating such impure things to a lady of my stature?
: I’m pretty much always being a bastard. I thought you knew that about me.
scene toukacampcall23
: Oh, I do. It’s actually rather pathetic.
: Yeah...I’m well aware.
: Are you?
: Yeah. But I’ll make it up to you soon. Does Saturday morning sound okay?
: Okay for what? You haven’t even informed me of what we’ll be doing yet.
: I’ll just take you out to eat or something and we can talk more about how much I suck for letting you wallow in worry for several months.
: Sounds wonderful. I’ll mark my calendar in anticipation of your expected groveling.
: There will be no groveling involved. Just food and likely depressing dialogue.
: Oh, then why don’t I just cancel now? Anyone can buy me food, Sensei. Such a thing won’t show me you care.
: So until you start expressing with both your actions and words that you regret the way you’ve treated me, I simply won’t believe you.
: You like the way I treat you, though.
: When it’s just teasing...I suppose I do. But this time was different.
: This time, you really hurt me.
scene toukacampcall24
: So I want you...to make up for it...
scene toukacampcall1
: I guess I’ll practice my dogeza then.
: Mm...I’m excited to see it...
: So...Saturday works then?
: Cool.
: Are you still there?
: Are you tired or something? You sound different.
: Yes...it’s been a long day...
: But you’ve made it a lot better by calling.
: Should I just hang up and...let you sleep then?
scene black
: Stay on the line a little longer.
Touka falls silent several minutes later and I’m left with nothing to do but...continue aimlessly wandering through the woods.
I’m not sure what she expects me to do come Saturday, but...
I can almost guarantee it won’t be what she wants.
All I can do is just hope it won’t stretch the wound out even further.
I want to keep her close.
Just as a different sort of tool than I’m used to.

scene clearnightsky
Now what?
